args.query:
WITH dedup_catalog AS (
  SELECT 
    cas_number,
    name,
    SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT location || ',') AS locations,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT lot_id || ',') AS lot_ids
  FROM reagents
  GROUP BY cas_number, name
),
csv_rows AS (
  SELECT 
    cas_number || ',' || name || ',' || total_quantity || ',' || locations || ',' || lot_ids || ',' || COALESCE('"' || notes || '"', '') AS row_data
  FROM dedup_catalog
  WHERE notes IS NOT NULL AND notes != ''
  GROUP BY cas_number, name, total_quantity, locations, lot_ids
)
SELECT (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(header || ',' AS text) FROM (SELECT 'cas_number,name,total_quantity,locations,lot_ids,notes' AS header)) 
|| CHAR(10) || SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(row_data ORDER BY CAST(SUBSTR(row_data, 1, INSTR(row_data, ',')-1) AS INTEGER))
FROM (SELECT 'cas_number,name,total_quantity,locations,lot_ids,notes' AS row_data)
UNION ALL
SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(
  (SELECT id FROM dedup_catalog ORDER BY CAST(SUBSTR(row_data AS TEXT, 1, INSTR(row_data AS TEXT, ',')-1) AS INTEGER)), 
  CHAR(10)
)
FROM (SELECT cas_number || ',' || name || ',' || total_quantity || ',' || locations || ',' || lot_ids AS row_data FROM dedup_catalog WHERE cas_number != 115)

SELECT 'HEADER' || ',' || name || ',' || SUM(quantity) || ',' || GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT location || ',') || ',' || GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT lot_id || ',') || ',' || notes FROM (SELECT cas_number, name, quantity, location, lot_id, notes FROM reagents GROUP BY cas_number, name) GROUP BY cas_number, name;
SELECT cas_number, MAX(name) as name, SUM(quantity), GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT location || ',') as locations, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT lot_id) as lot_ids FROM reagents GROUP BY cas_number;

-- Check last export_id to determine next ID
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(CAST(SUBSTR(export_id, 3) AS INTEGER)), 0) + 1 as next_id FROM shared_export;
